intro:

In a world where bugs and other alien creatures have invaded Earth, you're part of an elite team of soldiers fighting to reclaim the planet. But as you delve deeper into the game, you'll discover a rich and immersive world filled with secrets, side quests, and hidden treasures. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
